atoms.text:
Rocco is a raccoon. He lives in the Woolly Wood with all of his friends. They have a lot of fun together, but sometimes, they also have problems.

Meet Rocco and his friends and discover more about their feelings.

instruction.text: Read and follow along with Bear and Rocco’s conversation.

atoms.text: Rocco is a little upset with Bear.

atoms.b: Bear, you took my socks! I want to wear them today, and now I can’t.
atoms.sound: ssml: Bear, you took my socks! I want to wear them today, and now I can’t. <break time='500ms'/>

atoms.b: I thought they looked cool and wanted to wear them. They were just lying there.
atoms.sound: ssml: I thought they looked cool and wanted to wear them. They were just lying there.<break time='500ms'/>

atoms.b: But that’s not nice. You didn’t ask me if you could borrow them first.
atoms.sound: ssml: But that’s not nice. You didn’t ask me if you could borrow them first. <break time='500ms'/>

atoms.a: How does Rocco feel about Bear taking his socks?

end.text: That’s right, Rocco is feeling angry. He didn’t think it was nice of Bear to take his socks without asking first.

atoms.text:
Feelings can be difficult. They are not just something you feel, but also experience in your body.

Anger can help you understand that something is wrong and that you should probably talk about it.

instruction.text: Find different parts of Rocco to see how he and others can experience anger.

feedback.end: You can see Rocco is angry from his eyebrows because they are pointed down. Your body reacts and reveals your feelings, often without you even knowing. Sometimes, when people are really angry, they cry too.
Rocco’s mouth also shows how he is feeling. Tight lips or the corners of the lips pointing down are often signs that someone might be upset or angry. An open mouth can also sometimes show anger.
Some people feel angry in other parts of their body too. The tummy can feel upset and hurt when someone is angry.
Sometimes, your throat might feel clogged up and big or like it’s hard to swallow. Other people scream or shout when they feel anger.
Your heart can beat faster when you feel angry. Some people even sweat. It can take a while to return to normal.

atoms.text:
What’s important to know, is that feeling angry is normal. Everyone gets angry from time to time. People also feel and react to anger differently.

It is not wrong or bad to have these feelings. Rocco knows that he has to talk to Bear to make these feelings better.
